implied_expectations.method: 10-year constant-growth FCFE proxy from FY2027 revenue midpoint, 10% discount rate, 16x terminal owner-cash multiple.
implied_expectations.interpretation: At normalized owner-cash margins of 20-23%, the reference price embeds only about 3.6-5.4% annual revenue/owner-cash growth over the explicit period, materially below FY2027 company revenue guidance of 9-10%. This is a model inference, not a market consensus forecast.

bear.thesis: AI/low-cost competition limits pricing power; TurboTax and Mailchimp remain weak; core GBS still grows but decelerates.

base.thesis: QuickBooks/IES, money and TurboTax Live sustain upper-single-digit long-run growth; restructuring and mix support owner-cash margin expansion.

bull.thesis: Intuit becomes the trusted system-of-intelligence layer for SMB/consumer finance, Enterprise Suite scales, AI increases cross-sell and assisted-tax economics.

permanent_loss_case.description: AI agents commoditize tax/bookkeeping interface, low-cost alternatives erode TurboTax, Mailchimp remains impaired, pricing power fades and normalized owner-cash margin falls toward mid-teens.

notes: Scenario values are decision ranges, not point-price targets. FCFE proxy keeps SBC as a real compensation expense and does not add net debt separately.
